title: AI Agent Engineer at CollectWise | Y Combinator
excerpt: About Us CollectWise is a fast growing and well funded Y Combinator-backed startup. We’re using generative AI to automate debt collection, a $35B market in the US alone. Our AI agents are already outperforming human collectors by 2X, and we’re doing so at a fraction of the cost. With a team of five, we scaled to a $2 million annualized run rate in just a few months, and we are now hiring an AI Agent Engineer to help us reach $10 million within the next year. About the role CollectWise is hiring an AI Agent Engineer to build the infrastructure, prompting systems, and core architecture behind our voice AI agents. You will work at the intersection of AI infrastructure, prompt engineering, conversational design, and product development to build voice agents that power millions of consumer interactions. This is a highly technical role for someone who is equally comfortable building production-grade systems, writing and refining prompts and conversation flows, and designing rigorous testing frameworks to maximize real-world performance. You should be analytical, business-minded, and motivated by measurable outcomes. What you’ll do - Build our voice AI infrastructure in LiveKit - Design and own the architecture of our real-time voice agent systems, including orchestration, state management, latency optimization, prompting and reliability. - Own the end-to-end prompting strategy for CollectWise voice agents, including conversation flows, tone, compliance-safe phrasing, guardrails, and edge-case handling. - Build and maintain testing and evaluation frameworks for voice agent performance, including A/B testing, regression testing, conversation QA, benchmarking, and KPI reporting. - Write, expand, and improve our core AI prompting to cover more real-world scenarios. - Continuously iterate based on performance data, call outcomes, and customer feedback to improve containment, conversion, liquidation rates, and customer satisfaction. - Optimize ASR, STT, TTS, turn-taking, interruption handling, and state transitions to improve voice quality and agent performance. - Build scalable systems and tooling to support millions of voice interactions. - Migrate client implementations from legacy voice AI infrastructure to the latest systems you build, while preserving client-specific customizations and workflows. - Develop prompt and agent tooling, including versioning, rollout strategies, monitoring, safety checks, and debugging workflows. - Work closely with product, operations, and leadership to translate business goals into high-performing voice agent behavior. What we’re looking for - 2+ years of experience in voice AI, conversational AI, prompt engineering, speech systems, or related agentic workflows. - 3+ years of experience in platform, infrastructure, or backend engineering. - Strong experience with Node.js, AWS, and SQL. - Experience building and shipping production systems in a startup or similarly fast-paced environment. - Experience with voice orchestration platforms or agent frameworks such as LiveKit. - Strong prompt writing instincts and the ability to design clear, effective, and resilient conversational flows. - Strong analytical skills and comfort tying technical work directly to business outcomes and ROI. - Excellent communication skills, high ownership, and a strong work ethic. Nice to have - Experience with SIP trunking, telephony infrastructure, and production voice systems. - Experience working with real-time audio pipelines, call routing, and carrier or telephony integrations. - Familiarity with speech infrastructure in production environments. Compensation - Salary: $200,000 to $300,000, depending on experience and qualifications - Equity: 0.25% to 1%
content_html:
About Us

CollectWise is a fast growing and well funded Y Combinator-backed startup. We’re using generative AI to automate debt collection, a $35B market in the US alone. Our AI agents are already outperforming human collectors by 2X, and we’re doing so at a fraction of the cost.

With a team of five, we scaled to a $2 million annualized run rate in just a few months, and we are now hiring an AI Agent Engineer to help us reach $10 million within the next year.

About the role

CollectWise is hiring an AI Agent Engineer to build the infrastructure, prompting systems, and core architecture behind our voice AI agents. You will work at the intersection of AI infrastructure, prompt engineering, conversational design, and product development to build voice agents that power millions of consumer interactions.

This is a highly technical role for someone who is equally comfortable building production-grade systems, writing and refining prompts and conversation flows, and designing rigorous testing frameworks to maximize real-world performance. You should be analytical, business-minded, and motivated by measurable outcomes.

What you’ll do

  • Build our voice AI infrastructure in LiveKit
  • Design and own the architecture of our real-time voice agent systems, including orchestration, state management, latency optimization, prompting and reliability.
  • Own the end-to-end prompting strategy for CollectWise voice agents, including conversation flows, tone, compliance-safe phrasing, guardrails, and edge-case handling.
  • Build and maintain testing and evaluation frameworks for voice agent performance, including A/B testing, regression testing, conversation QA, benchmarking, and KPI reporting.
  • Write, expand, and improve our core AI prompting to cover more real-world scenarios.
  • Continuously iterate based on performance data, call outcomes, and customer feedback to improve containment, conversion, liquidation rates, and customer satisfaction.
  • Optimize ASR, STT, TTS, turn-taking, interruption handling, and state transitions to improve voice quality and agent performance.
  • Build scalable systems and tooling to support millions of voice interactions.
  • Migrate client implementations from legacy voice AI infrastructure to the latest systems you build, while preserving client-specific customizations and workflows.
  • Develop prompt and agent tooling, including versioning, rollout strategies, monitoring, safety checks, and debugging workflows.
  • Work closely with product, operations, and leadership to translate business goals into high-performing voice agent behavior.

What we’re looking for

  • 2+ years of experience in voice AI, conversational AI, prompt engineering, speech systems, or related agentic workflows.
  • 3+ years of experience in platform, infrastructure, or backend engineering.
  • Strong experience with Node.js, AWS, and SQL.
  • Experience building and shipping production systems in a startup or similarly fast-paced environment.
  • Experience with voice orchestration platforms or agent frameworks such as LiveKit.
  • Strong prompt writing instincts and the ability to design clear, effective, and resilient conversational flows.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort tying technical work directly to business outcomes and ROI.
  • Excellent communication skills, high ownership, and a strong work ethic.

Nice to have

  • Experience with SIP trunking, telephony infrastructure, and production voice systems.
  • Experience working with real-time audio pipelines, call routing, and carrier or telephony integrations.
  • Familiarity with speech infrastructure in production environments.

Compensation

  • Salary: $200,000 to $300,000, depending on experience and qualifications
  • Equity: 0.25% to 1%

CollectWise is revolutionizing debt recovery with autonomous AI agents and an integrated legal network. We boost recovery rates, reduce costs, and maintain a positive brand image through respectful, data-driven interactions.

content_html_zh:
关于我们

CollectWise 是一家快速发展且资金充足、由 Y Combinator 支持的初创公司。 我们正在使用生成式人工智能来自动追收债务，仅在美国就有一个 35B 美元的市场。 我们的人工智能代理的表现已经比人类收藏家高出 2 倍，而且我们的成本只是人类收藏家的一小部分。

凭借一个五人团队，我们在短短几个月内就将年化运行率扩大到了 200 万美元，现在我们正在招聘一名 AI 代理工程师，以帮助我们在明年达到 1000 万美元的目标。

关于角色

CollectWise 正在招聘一名人工智能代理工程师来构建我们的语音人工智能代理背后的基础设施、提示系统和核心架构。 您将在人工智能基础设施、即时工程、对话式设计和产品开发的交叉领域工作，以构建为数百万消费者互动提供支持的语音代理。

对于同样擅长构建生产级系统、编写和完善提示和对话流程以及设计严格的测试框架以最大限度地提高实际性能的人员来说，这是一个技术含量很高的角色。 您应该具有分析能力、商业头脑并受到可衡量结果的激励。

你会做什么

  • 在 LiveKit 中构建我们的语音 AI 基础设施
  • 设计并拥有我们的实时语音代理系统的架构，包括编排、状态管理、延迟优化、提示和可靠性。
  • 拥有 CollectWise 语音代理的端到端提示策略，包括对话流程、语气、合规安全措辞、护栏和边缘情况处理。
  • 构建和维护语音代理性能的测试和评估框架，包括 A/B 测试、回归测试、对话 QA、基准测试和 KPI 报告。
  • 编写、扩展和改进我们的核心人工智能提示，以覆盖更多的现实场景。
  • 根据绩效数据、通话结果和客户反馈不断迭代，以提高遏制率、转化率、清算率和客户满意度。
  • 优化 ASR、STT、TTS、轮流、中断处理和状态转换，以提高语音质量和座席性能。
  • 构建可扩展的系统和工具来支持数百万次语音交互。
  • 将客户端实施从传统语音 AI 基础设施迁移到您构建的最新系统，同时保留特定于客户端的自定义和工作流程。
  • 开发提示和代理工具，包括版本控制、部署策略、监控、安全检查和调试工作流程。
  • 与产品、运营和领导层密切合作，将业务目标转化为高性能的语音代理行为。

我们正在寻找什么

  • 在语音 AI、对话式 AI、提示工程、语音系统或相关代理工作流程方面拥有 2 年以上经验。
  • 拥有 3 年以上平台、基础设施或后端工程经验。
  • 在 Node.js、AWS 和 SQL 方面拥有丰富的经验。
  • 拥有在初创公司或类似的快节奏环境中构建和交付生产系统的经验。
  • 拥有语音编排平台或代理框架（例如 LiveKit）的经验。
  • 强大的即时写作本能以及设计清晰、有效和有弹性的对话流程的能力。
  • 强大的分析能力和舒适度将技术工作直接与业务成果和投资回报率联系起来。
  • 优秀的沟通技巧、高度的主人翁精神和强烈的职业道德。

很高兴拥有

  • 具有 SIP 中继、电话基础设施和生产语音系统方面的经验。
  • 具有使用实时音频管道、呼叫路由以及运营商或电话集成的经验。
  • 熟悉生产环境中的语音基础设施。
